contradictions: Where the History freeze wedges is disputed. L01 says the first instance's main-process JS event loop is stuck, so `second-instance` is never delivered. B1 RC3 says main is free: second-instance reaches ensureWindow(), which no-ops because the window is visible but only the renderer is blocked by window.confirm(). These are mutually exclusive and lead to different fixes (main-process watchdog vs renderer isResponsive() recovery). No lane reproduced it.

Three lanes each name a different P0 for the same 'running but frozen' symptom: B1 says window.confirm in guardReviewNav, B3 says unbounded render-process-gone reload, L01 says a single-instance lock with no liveness check. Severity for the same defect also diverges: B1 rates 'unresponsive only logs' P0/P1, B3 §8 rates it P2. L06 'confirmed' B1 F1 only after reading B1 first (L06:39), so it is not independent verification. B1's guard fires only when view==='review' and reviewDirty, which does not obviously explain a History click from a non-Review state.
